plain_statement.zh: 用不超过 y 的奇素因子预测实际大弧系数，在偶目标带上证明均方误差为 O(y⁻²)。
plain_statement.en: Bound mean-square error of the small-prime model by O(y⁻²) on the reflected band.

brief.zh: 固定 y 后让 N 增长。有限模型只读目标的少量局部信息；误差上界要求绝对常数独立于 y。可先对截断 Ramanujan 和做正交，再把有限素因子模型与完整二阶 Euler 乘积比较。
brief.en: After fixing y take N large. Bound the actual coefficient in mean square by a model using only small prime divisors, with an absolute constant. Try Ramanujan orthogonality followed by a second-moment Euler product tail estimate.
